newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates close steady, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates close steady, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Thursday and are likely to ease in the next few days on increased supplies from the new (1997/98 July-June) crop from farms to ginneries, dealers said.
Increased supplies of cotton kept prices unchanged, one dealer said. Spinners are in the market but exporters had slowed purchases, he added.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted for 2,325/2,350 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), the K-68 for 2,550/2,570 and the MNH-93 for 2,550/2,565.
